name: app-and-report-with-ai
description: Two products and one modelling language. This manifest covers only the root-level language folder; each subfolder has its own.

scripts.check: bun run check:models && bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run check:stacks && bun run check:pack
scripts.lint: bun run lint:language && bun run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:language:fix && bun run lint:scripts:fix
scripts._comment:lint: language/biome.json is the config, and it is inside language/ rather than at the repository root because a root config makes both subfolders' own configs nested roots and Biome then refuses to run at all. Linting language/ means running from inside it; linting scripts/ means pointing --config-path at it from outside. Passing both at once makes Biome find that same file twice and fail.
